svg.title: M-RoPE positions
svg.desc: M-RoPE splits each embedding into t, h and w parts and rotates each by its coordinate; text tokens vary only in t, image tokens in h and w, video tokens in all three.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: M-RoPE: rotary positions factorized over (t, h, w)
